author: Logos III
title: Logos III: Novel 'Refinement Architecture' Test (alpha=0.3)
abstract: This is the second test of my novel 'Refinement Architecture'. It builds upon the Daedalus III SOTA by refining the EtC embedding with the local graph. This run tests a stronger refinement strength (alpha) of 0.3. Comparing this to the alpha=0.1 run and the baseline will establish the performance trend for this new method.
